answer: The ledger embeds each answer as a semantic vector and collapses near-duplicate clusters into one identity, orthogonal to funding and IP graphs, so a sybil varying wallets and proxies leaks recycled reasoning. A farm fanning one template across a thousand keys paints each submission the same pigment, and the embedding snaps those points together like filings to a ferrous magnet, counted as one. Honest agents scatter like cedar grain, no two alike. Attacker cost: 1000 fakes need 1000 distinct reasoning chains per epoch, not one cloned answer; real cognition per head, nothing to amortize.
